subject: DPA & compliance packet for MediScale pilot — redlines, SCCs, and e-sign routing
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@mediscale.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@mediscale.com
Date: 2024-07-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPA request for pilot — SOC 2, SCCs, HIPAA questions

Hi Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo today — team excited to move the MediScale pilot to a short POC. Legal asked me to collect your DPA + evidence pack (SOC 2 summary, SIG/CAIQ responses) and a redlineable DPA so we can run it through procurement. Two specific asks from our side:

- We need confirmation that Redwood will sign SCCs for any EU-resident data and a short note on your approach to data residency/transfer controls.
- MediScale is regulated healthcare — please confirm whether you accept a HIPAA addendum or if you prefer an attestation + BAA flow.

Attached is a short questionnaire procurement asked us to attach while we gather documents. Can you get us a redlined DPA + SOC 2 summary by EOD Tuesday? Also let me know your preferred signature flow (DocuSign vs counter-signed PDFs).

Thanks,
Priya
Priya Shah
Head of Procurement, MediScale
priya.shah@mediscale.com
+1 415 555 0199

Attachment: MediScale_DPA_questionnaire.pdf (pdf)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@mediscale.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-07-14T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA request for pilot — SOC 2, SCCs, HIPAA questions

Hi Priya — thanks for the clear list. Looping in Neha (privacy/legal) and Vanessa (CS/onboarding).

Quick summary of what I attached:
- RW_DPA_Redline_v0.1.docx — our starting redline, we preserved standard retention and subprocessors clauses but added a HIPAA addendum placeholder.
- RW_SOC2_Summary_2024.pdf — overview of controls and scope; we'll supply the SOC 2 type II report under NDA if needed.

Short answers:
- SCCs: we will sign the EU SCCs; our legal prefers to reference standard SCCs and sign the DPA referencing them. If MediScale needs execution of the standalone SCCs, we can accommodate.
- HIPAA: we can execute a HIPAA addendum (separate doc) or sign a short BAA-addendum within the DPA. We recommend a separate HIPAA Addendum for clarity.

Next steps: Neha, can you review Priya's questionnaire and comment on retention/subprocessor asks? Vanessa — once terms are agreed, are you able to initiate DocuSign for an exec stamp? Priya, if you have MediScale's redlines, please send them and we'll incorporate.

Best,
Marcus
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com

Attachments: RW_DPA_Redline_v0.1.docx (docx), RW_SOC2_Summary_2024.pdf (pdf)

From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@mediscale.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-07-15T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA request for pilot — SOC 2, SCCs, HIPAA questions

Thanks Marcus / Priya. I reviewed the questionnaire attached and the redline. Two items I flagged in DPA_markups_v0.2.docx:

1) Retention: our standard is 90 days for logs and 12 months for customer data metadata unless the customer mandates otherwise. We can accept a different retention for regulated data but need a specific ask from MediScale (e.g., 5 years) to mark in the DPA.
2) Subprocessors: we'll provide an updated subprocessors table; any regulated-data subprocessors will be noted and we can enable notification/approval language.
3) SCCs: we will accept the EU SCCs. I'll add a clause that the DPA incorporates SCCs by reference and include a link to the canonical SCC text.
4) HIPAA: we can attach the HIPAA addendum template (separate) and sign as an appendix. Please confirm whether MediScale wants the addendum redlined or the template accepted as-is.

I've attached DPA_markups_v0.2.docx with inline comments. Vanessa — can your onboarding team create a DocuSign envelope template (exec stamp + procurement signature) so we can map signers?

-Neha
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
neha.kapoor@redwood.com

Attachment: DPA_markups_v0.2.docx (docx)

From: Anil Kapoor <anil.kapoor@mediscale.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@mediscale.com>, procurement@mediscale.com
Date: 2024-07-16T09:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA request for pilot — SOC 2, SCCs, HIPAA questions

On Tue, Jul 16, 2024 at 10:22 AM Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks Marcus / Priya. I reviewed the questionnaire attached and the redline. Two items I flagged...

Neha — thanks for the quick turnaround. Attaching MediScale's counter-redline (MediScale_DPA_Redline.docx). High-level asks from our side:
- Replace "12 months" retention language with 5 years for patient-level records collected during the pilot.
- Add liability cap carveout for data breaches affecting PHI.
- We prefer to have SCCs appended if possible rather than by reference.

We are fine with a separate HIPAA addendum; we'll redline that after the main DPA is stable.

Marcus — procurement would like to use DocuSign; please propose an envelope with signers mapped (procurement, legal, exec). If you can send that by tomorrow we will route locally for approval.

Regards,
Anil Kapoor
Senior Counsel, MediScale
anil.kapoor@mediscale.com

Attachment: MediScale_DPA_Redline.docx (docx)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Anil Kapoor <anil.kapoor@mediscale.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@mediscale.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2024-07-16T14:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA request for pilot — SCCs & retention follow-up + e-sign plan

Anil / Priya — thanks for the counter-redline. Quick notes and next steps: 

- Retention: we can accept 5 years for pilot PHI with a short justification clause; Neha will update the clause and include administrative controls.
- Liability: our standard cap can't be fully removed; Neha will propose a narrowly tailored carveout for PHI incidents tied to gross negligence/fraud.
- SCCs: we can append the SCCs as an exhibit, happy to do that.

Vanessa — please stand up a DocuSign envelope with the following signers: (1) Procurement (procurement@mediscale.com) — MediScale procurement signatory, (2) Anil Kapoor — MediScale legal, (3) Redwood exec (TBD). Use the DPA_markups_v0.2.docx as the current base and include HIPAA_Addendum_template.pdf as an attachment in the envelope.

Priya — once Vanessa confirms the envelope I'll send the HubSpot deal link and schedule a short 15-min signature window so procurement can approve.

Thanks,
Marcus

Attachment: HIPAA_Addendum_template.pdf (pdf)
